tickets.title: Open and Prepare New Account
tickets.text: Use this workflow to prepare, submit, and confirm a new client account opening package for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz. Confirm account purpose, registration type, funding path, required disclosures, and operational readiness before considering the account complete. The new joint taxable advisory account at Velvet Acorn Custody will use transfer-on-death registration, hold cash above the household reserve target and anticipated estate cash, reflect a moderate-growth objective with tax sensitivity, and avoid adding to the existing Paper Otter Analytics concentration.

subTasks.title: Confirm account profile and registration
subTasks.text: Verify the intended account type, ownership or registration, tax classification if applicable, investment objective, risk tolerance, and any special restrictions before paperwork is prepared. For Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz, confirm the joint taxable account with transfer-on-death registration, moderate-growth objective, tax sensitivity, and the preference to avoid adding to the existing Paper Otter Analytics concentration.

subTasks.title: Prepare and review account documents
subTasks.text: Complete the custodian or platform forms, advisory agreement items, fee schedule references, beneficiary fields if applicable, and required disclosures. Review for missing signatures, inconsistent addresses, and incomplete identity information.

subTasks.title: Submit opening package and track approval
subTasks.text: Submit the account package through the appropriate channel and monitor for approval, rejection, or additional information requests. Record any follow-up items in the client record.

subTasks.title: Confirm funding and first operational setup
subTasks.text: Confirm funding instructions, transfer status, cash availability, model or allocation setup, statement delivery preference, and online access readiness before closing the workflow. Funding will come from cash above the household reserve target at Teacup Comet Bank and from anticipated estate cash once received.

tickets.evidence: Nolan asked to set up a new joint taxable advisory account with transfer-on-death registration for cash above the household reserve target and for anticipated estate cash once received.

tickets.text: Prepare a year-end tax projection and charitable funding analysis for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz. Coordinate withholding, estimated tax exposure, appreciated-share giving from the Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account, and whether a larger charitable gift should be made before year-end, including their recurring support to Silver Marmot Arts Fund.

tickets.title: Gather Inheritance Intake Details
tickets.text: Collect the core facts needed to evaluate an inheritance event for Nolan Pebblefizz from the estate of his mother Adele Pebblefizz, including the expected asset types, estimated timing, estate contact information, beneficiary status, tax documents expected, and any immediate cash flow or investment implications. Do not request sensitive account numbers unless required through secure channels. The executor has informally estimated about $220,000 in cash plus a fractional inherited IRA interest; the client file still needs the estate inventory, beneficiary confirmation, inherited IRA custodian notice, and expected distribution schedule.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to complete the inheritance intake for Adele Pebblefizz’s estate by 2024-10-30.

tickets.text: Reconcile the cost basis discrepancy for Nolan Pebblefizz's Paper Otter Analytics tax lots between his spreadsheet and the Velvet Acorn Custody unrealized gain report. The discrepancy affects which shares may be suitable for charitable gifting or trimming as part of the concentration-management discussion.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the Paper Otter Analytics stock basis by 2024-11-08.

tickets.text: Prepare coordination points for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz to send to their estate attorney. Address the guardianship provisions created when both children were minors and the successor trustee who has since moved overseas, in light of the current family situation.
